important_notes: Do not invent missing prices, sizes, materials, ratings, descriptions, or image URLs.
Amazon, AJIO, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra and some other retailers may use anti-bot/JavaScript controls, so automated fetching can fail or become stale.
Prices, discounts, ratings, stock and availability are dynamic. Re-fetch/verify them immediately before final import if accuracy matters.
Retailer product images may be copyrighted or subject to site terms. Do not hotlink. For a public/commercial deployment, use images you have permission/licence to reuse.
Three submitted Amazon URLs were missing the URL scheme; canonical_url fixes them.
Tracking parameters were removed from canonical_url where possible; variant/pid was retained when useful.
For missing images/details, Codex should report the product instead of fabricating data.
